proposed_behavior: Keep original and recovery receipts in audit history. Publish a reconciled current statement with source-linked confirmed facts, explicit unresolved parts and stable final finding IDs. Do not simply strip caveats or concatenate unreviewed claims.
required_controls: Confirmed recovery replaces only its corresponding stale limitation.
Unresolved claims and conditional solutions survive reconciliation.
Claim/reason disagreement stays unresolved until adjudicated.
No internal request-local ID is exposed as if it were a final finding ID.
F-009 and F-063/F-064 are reconciled without losing either quantity atom.
